purpose: Independent practice of decoding CVC words in short sentences.
student_learning_goal: I can decode CVC words in a sentence.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can decode CVC words in a sentence.
header.character_watermark: Sounder Sam and Blendy in the top-right pointing at a sentence strip with a finger pointer. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Read each sentence. Circle the CVC words you decoded.
parts.visual_layout: Three sentence rows printed in large clear font with circle space around each CVC word for marking.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 sentence-read layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 3 sentences in large font: 'The cat sat on a mat.', 'Pat the dog.', 'A pig in a hat.' Each CVC word has space around it for the child to circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_SENTENCE at Part 1: keywords name the sentence rows and circle-the-CVC-word task.

parts.answer_key: Circled: cat, sat, mat, Pat, dog, pig, hat.

parts.student_instructions: Read each sentence. Draw a line to its picture.
parts.visual_layout: Three sentences on the left and three picture choices on the right with connecting space for match lines.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 sentence-to-picture match layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 3 sentences ('A pig in a hat.', 'The dog sat on a bed.', 'A cat on a bus.'). Right column: 3 picture scenes matching each. Connecting space between for match lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_MATCH at Part 2: keywords name the sentence and picture match task across two columns.

parts.answer_key: Each sentence to its matching picture.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a CVC word from the box. Write it in the blank.
parts.visual_layout: Two sentences with a blank where one CVC word is missing and a word bank box at the top with five word choices.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 fill-in-the-blank layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. Word bank box at top: cat, dog, sun, mat, pin. Two sentences below with a blank: 'The ___ sat in a hat.' and 'A pig on the ___.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_FILL at Part 3: keywords name the sentence and blank fill-in task with word bank.

parts.answer_key: Sample: 'cat' for first blank, 'mat' for second.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write your own short sentence using a CVC word.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Formative — confirm child reads through sentences without freezing at unknowns and re-reads for sense.
